description: This is a C header file (lm_wrapper_priv.h) defining internal function prototypes and include guards for LAN management functionalities, including stopping scans, getting LAN host comments, setting LAN host comments, and getting Ethernet port information.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_stop_scan
methods.description: Function to stop LAN scan operations.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_getLanHostComments
methods.description: Function to retrieve comments for a LAN host identified by physical address.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_set_lan_host_comments
methods.description: Function to set comments for a LAN host.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_getEthernetPort
methods.description: Function to get Ethernet port information based on MAC address.
